description: This file defines the class GenericMapEntry, which implements the Map.Entry interface for handling key-value pairs within a custom map implementation. It provides methods to access and modify entries, with custom logic for getting values and computing hash codes.

classes.name: GenericMapEntry
classes.description: Implementation of the Map.Entry interface for a custom map structure, encapsulating key-value pairs with additional note access logic.

methods.name: GenericMapEntry
methods.description: Constructor initializing the map, key, and noteAccess flag.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key associated with this entry.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value from the map corresponding to the key, considering noteAccess flag.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a new value for the key in the map.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines if this entry is equal to another object based on key and value equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code for this entry based on key and value.
